title: GitHub Notes Viewer — Internal Tree Contract
description: The shape the app constructs from GitHub's recursive Git Trees API response before handing it to the tree widget. Maps one-to-one onto the TreeNode entity documented in data-model.md.

raw_github_response.truncated: boolean — true when the repo has >100k entries; should not happen for personal notes repos under the scope constraint
raw_github_response.sha: string — commit SHA of the base ref (default_branch)

tree.path: string — forward-slash relative path from repo root
tree.size: number — bytes, present only for blobs

id.description: Stable identifier derived from path: slashes replaced with hyphens, root becomes 'root'. Used as ARIA node ID.

label.description: Basename portion of path. Displayed verbatim including dotfiles.

path.description: Full forward-slash path. Identity key into the Note map for blob nodes.

type.description: Mirrors the GitHub type field. Directories are expandable; blobs are leaf notes (when .md).

sha.description: SHA used for staleness detection. Not displayed to the user.

size.description: Size in bytes. Omitted or zero for tree nodes.

children.description: Nested child nodes for directory-type entries. Undefined on leaf blobs.

construction_rules.sorting: entries sorted lexicographically by path so sibling order mirrors GitHub
construction_rules.pruning: intermediate directories containing no .md descendants are omitted from the final tree
construction_rules.leaf_filter: only paths ending with '.md' become leaf nodes; other blobs are invisible to the tree
construction_rules.empty_repo_behavior: empty tree array renders an empty-state message per Edge Cases rather than an error

rate_limit_considerations.cacheability: response includes cache-control: public, max-age=60; browser/CDN cache is leveraged without custom logic
rate_limit_considerations.re-fetch_trigger: repo change or explicit refresh action
